title: Model Weights, Airlocks and Sandboxes: A Call for Technical Validation of Re-identification Tests under the EDPB Anonymisation Guidelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.34859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Guidelines 02/2026 on anonymisation of the European Data Protection Board (EDPB), published for consultation in July 2026, assess anonymity relative to the entities that may access data. They bring AI models into scope and call for testing, but do not say how a re-identification test should be designed or validated, or how far its result counts as evidence. Building on our reply to the consultation, we describe a framework based on a secure processing environment whose outputs are reviewed before release (an airlock), and distinguish forms of release and three types of evidence: formal, empirical and indirect. We raise seven open questions, each with a scenario, and examine their technical side in three settings: the release of model weights (the trained parameters of a machine learning model), review at an airlock, and regulatory sandboxes, in which an authority supervises development and testing. translated_title: 模型权重、气闸与沙盒：呼吁在EDPB匿名化指南下对重识别测试进行技术验证
translated_abstract: 欧洲数据保护委员会（EDPB）于2026年7月发布征求意见的《02/2026号匿名化指南》，从可能访问数据的实体角度来评估匿名性。该指南将AI模型纳入适用范围并要求进行测试，但并未说明重识别测试应如何设计或验证，也未说明其结果在多大程度上可算作证据。基于我们对征求意见的回复，我们提出了一个基于安全处理环境的框架，其输出在发布前须经审查（即“气闸”机制），并区分了不同的发布形式和三种类型的证据：形式化证据、经验证据和间接证据。我们提出了七个开放性问题，每个问题均配有具体场景，并在三种情境下考察其技术层面：模型权重（机器学习模型的训练参数）的发布、气闸处的审查，以及由监管机构监督开发与测试的监管沙盒。在每种情境下，评估……
tldr: 针对EDPB匿名化指南将AI模型纳入监管却未规定重识别测试如何设计与验证的问题，本文提出了基于气闸式安全处理环境的评估框架，区分形式化、经验和间接三类证据，并在模型权重发布、气闸审查和监管沙盒三种场景下提出并探讨了七个开放性技术问题。
en_tdlr: The paper calls for technical validation of re-identification tests under the EDPB anonymisation guidelines, proposing an airlock-based secure processing framework that distinguishes formal, empirical, and indirect evidence, and examining seven open questions across model weight release, airlock review, and regulatory sandbox settings.
